description: Black meets the English with the solid 1...e6, keeping the center flexible. White develops naturally with Nf3 and g3, Black responds with ...d5 and ...Nf6. Both sides fianchetto and castle into a Queen's Gambit-like structure with colors reversed.

lines.description: After 1.c4 e6 2.Nf3 d5, White plays 3.g3 and Black develops 3...Nf6. White fianchettoes 4.Bg2 Be7, and both sides castle 5.O-O O-O. Black's ...e6/d5 setup is rock-solid; White's g2 bishop and central breaks with d4 will define the middlegame.
lines.name: English Opening — Agincourt Defense
